title: MeshPack Index Shard
description: Sharded file index containing a subset of file entries. See common.schema.json for shared definitions.

shard_id.description: Shard identifier matching filename (e.g., part-00001). 1-based, 5-digit zero-padded.

format_version.description: MUST match the format_version in manifest.json

entries_hash.description: Hash of the canonical JSON serialization of the sorted entries array. Computed per REQ-L2-010 using RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization.

entries_count.description: Number of entries in this shard. MUST match entries.length.

creator_info.description: DEPRECATED: For backwards compatibility only. New implementations MUST omit this and rely on manifest.creator_info. Will be removed in format_version 2.0.0.

entries.description: Array of file entries sorted by 'path' (UTF-8 byte order). MUST NOT exceed 10,000 entries per shard (REQ-L2-003).

path.description: Relative path from root, POSIX separators only (/). MUST NOT contain '..', absolute paths, or drive letters.

ids.description: Identifiers for this file in multiple namespaces (e.g., meshsync:model, thingiverse:thing)

original_name.description: Original filename (preserving case, may differ from path basename)

hash.description: Content hash of the ORIGINAL file on the source filesystem

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., model/stl, model/gltf-binary)

units.description: Measurement units for 3D geometry. 'unitless' if format does not specify.

up_axis.description: Up-axis orientation of the SOURCE model file. Note: assembly transforms use the canonical +Y-up coordinate system regardless of this value.

bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in the SOURCE file's coordinate system. Units are inherited from the sibling 'units' field. Use 'up_axis' to interpret orientation.

min.description: [x, y, z] minimum corner in source coordinate system

max.description: [x, y, z] maximum corner in source coordinate system

resource_ref.description: If not null, references a file in resources/ named as {hex_hash}.{ext} (no algo prefix — algo is implicit from manifest.hash_algo). Colons are avoided for Windows compatibility.

resource_hash.description: Hash of the embedded resource file in resources/. May differ from 'hash' if resource is a derivative (e.g., compressed thumbnail).

resource_size_bytes.description: Size of the embedded resource file in bytes

metamodel_id.description: DEPRECATED: Single metamodel ID. Use 'metamodels' array for 1:N support. Kept for v1.0 backward compatibility; if both present, 'metamodels' takes precedence.

metamodel_role.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'metamodels' array with per-assignment roles.

metamodels.description: Array of metamodel memberships. A file can belong to multiple metamodels. Supersedes metamodel_id/metamodel_role when present.

assembly.description: Assembly graph info. Transform is 4x4 column-major matrix in CANONICAL coordinate system (+Y up, right-handed, per glTF convention). Transforms are relative to parent assembly, not world space. If the source file uses a different up_axis, the transform MUST be pre-converted to canonical +Y up.

transform.description: 4x4 homogeneous transform matrix in column-major order (OpenGL/glTF convention)

preview_ref.description: Reference to preview thumbnail in resources/ (format: {hex_hash}.{ext})

operation.description: Delta pack operation. Only present when manifest.generation.partial=true. 'delete' entries MUST have size_bytes=0 and hash set to all zeros.

extensions.description: Extension data. Keys MUST use namespace prefixes. Reserved prefix '_' is for spec-defined control fields.

_deleted.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy delta pack deletion marker. Use 'operation: delete' instead. Kept for v1.0 backward compatibility.
